snippet.title: Malcolm in Thailand
snippet.description:
Want to know where your money goes further in Thailand and Southeast Asia?

On this channel, I compare places, prices, condos, neighborhoods, and lifestyles so you can see what different budgets actually buy.

From Bangkok condos to Hua Hin villas, Cha-Am beach towns, Chiang Mai neighborhoods, Pattaya, Jomtien, Da Nang, Ho Chi Minh City, and beyond, I break down the real cost of living without the fantasy.

Expect budget battles, city comparisons, condo tours, retirement numbers, moving costs, visa talk, and honest lifestyle breakdowns for people thinking about living, retiring, or spending serious time in Asia.

No influencer highlight reels. Just real numbers, real places, and real trade-offs.

snippet.title: Dream Big and Retire
snippet.description:
Welcome to Dream Big and Retire! My name is April, and I’m here to help you explore amazing places to retire in the United States and around the world.

From tropical beaches to affordable hidden gems, we cover real-world information like cost of living, healthcare, safety, housing, visas, local culture, and what everyday life is actually like in these destinations.

We work hard to research each location using information available at the time of posting, but prices, visa rules, healthcare, and local conditions can change, so always verify important details independently.

We also do our best to use real photos and footage from each destination whenever possible, though some visuals may occasionally be representative images.

So, grab some coffee, hit that subscribe button, and come explore the world with us as we discover some of the best places to retire and travel.

snippet.title: Walking In My Shoes
snippet.description:
Walking in My Shoes 🌏👣  Also known as Walking In My Shoes Thailand

We left the Matrix behind — the 9-to-5 grind, the routine, the noise — and chose to see the world for ourselves. This is what happens when you stop watching life through a screen and start living it in your own shoes.

Welcome! We're out here exploring the world one step at a time — from the streets of America to bustling Asian cities, serene beaches, majestic mountains, and hidden gems most travelers never find.

Come along as we explore the USA, savor street food in Asia, hike through Europe, uncover the charm of remote islands, and dive into the vibrant cultures that make every destination unique. Expect stunning visuals, honest travel tips, cultural insights, and plenty of inspiration for your next adventure.

Life's too short to stay plugged into the Matrix. Don't just dream it — walk it with us. 🌍✨
Subscribe and let's wander the world together.

snippet.title: Sam Smart
snippet.description:
Welcome! This channel documents my expat retirement in Thailand, offering honest insights into navigating expat life's challenges and triumphs.

Currently, all my videos feature Hua Hin, providing a deep dive into living in this coastal city.

We cover everything from Thai language hurdles, social isolation, and visa complexities to cost of living, cultural adaptation, and unexpected adventures.

If you're planning to retire in Thailand, specifically considering Hua Hin, or just looking for practical tips on living abroad, this is for you!

Don't miss out! Subscribe for grounded perspectives on building a rewarding life in Southeast Asia! 🔔

New videos every week or two! 🎬

snippet.title: Abi | Life Beyond The Comfort Zone
snippet.description:
Hi, I’m Abi, a Londoner in her 30's who traded corporate HR life for adventure, freedom, and a one-way ticket to Thailand. 

On this channel, I share my journey of moving to Thailand to teach English, exploring Asia as a solo female traveller, and building a life that’s a little different from the ‘expected path.’

You’ll find travel guides, safety tips, cultural experiences, and honest insights into solo female travel - plus my bigger mission: creating a supportive community for women who want to explore the world with confidence (and maybe even join group trips in the future!).

If you’ve ever dreamed of solo travel, moving abroad, or just need inspiration to take that leap - you’re in the right place. 

Travel. Learn. Grow. Repeat.
